profile.name: Jason Wu
profile.tagline:
Full stack engineer in NYC. 
Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, and a soft spot for machine learning.
profile.typingLine: I build web apps and teach machines to read.

points: Built a trading dashboard in Next.js and TypeScript where order books and alpha signals stream in live, and the UI keeps up.
Wired the ML backends to the screen with a real-time pipeline, so signals and Greeks reach dense charts intact.
Wrote the FastAPI endpoints that let the frontend and quant teams talk, and helped ship ML-driven smart order routers for institutional trading.
Worked with the quants to plug in their models; average trade slippage dropped 12%.
Kept portfolio and watchlist views in sync with Redux Toolkit, powering live Value at Risk and margin numbers.
Made it 38% faster to load (SSR, smarter fetching, memoization) and 61% faster to test (Cypress, CI/CD on GitHub Actions).
Built responsive UI in Next.js, TypeScript and GraphQL, queries and mutations included.
Brought in Storybook so components could be built, tested and documented in one place.
Rebuilt the v1 codebase as v2 with modern Next.js, React hooks, React-Aria and React-Resizable.
Ran Git workflow talks for the team and joined the Scrum rituals.
- 2nd place - International ICT Innovative Services Competition
- Excellence Award - TKU Information Management Project Competition.

projects.title: Pokémon Interactive Map
projects.description: An interactive map and data explorer for Pokémon Gen 1 and Gen 2. It has overworld navigation, bilingual Japanese and English dialogue, encounter and trainer tables, a full Pokédex, and a solver that finds dungeon routes in real time. Everything is extracted from the decompilation source, not guessed.

projects.title: MarketLens
projects.description: A Firstrade portfolio viewer. Upload your account-history CSVs and see holdings at any date, cost basis, realized P/L, dividends and yearly summaries, all in a pixel-art interface. Your data never leaves the browser.

projects.title: Firstrade Portfolio Dashboard
projects.description: A Full-stack web app with FastAPI, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Recharts to visualize trading data and portfolio performance
projects.tech_stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, FastAPI, yfinance

projects.title: Firstrade Portfolio Analysis (Deprecated)
projects.description: This suite of Python scripts and Jupyter notebook reconstructs a complete Firstrade portfolio transaction history from CSV data. It enables precise tracking of portfolio evolution, detailed performance analysis over any time period, and accurate return calculations that account for dividends, reinvestments, and corporate actions like stock splits.

projects.title: Bank Ledger System
projects.description: Developed a bank ledger system implementing the Event Sourcing pattern to maintain an immutable transaction history, ensuring auditability and reconstruction of account balances.

projects.title: Seq2Seq Translation Model
projects.description: A seq2seq model to translate French text into English using the iwslt2017 dataset, processing over 50,000 sentence pairs.

projects.title: Stock Price Forecast
projects.description: A LSTM model designed to forecast stock prices based on historical data, trained using a variety of features and technical indicators. It achieves an average R^2 score of 0.96 and an average Mean Absolute Percentage Error of 0.1%.

projects.title: Visual Board
projects.description: An interactive stock dashboard featuring historical data charts, market recommendations, and stock analysis.

projects.title: IMDB Movie Review Analysis (Word2Vec)
projects.description: A Word2Vec Skip-Gram model developed with TensorFlow to analyze and generate word embeddings from the IMDB movie review dataset, enhancing understanding of semantic word relationships.

projects.title: Author Classification (MLP)
projects.description: A Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) model, fully coded from scratch in Python, to classify sentences by their corresponding authors. It employs tokenization and TF-IDF vectorization with optimization, regularization, and cross-validation.

projects.title: Stevens Marketplace
projects.description: A community-centric platform that facilitates the discovery and management of pre-owned items, featuring seamless and secure real-time messaging.
projects.tech_stack: JavaScript, React, GraphQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Redux, Redis

projects.title: Event Master
projects.description: A full-stack web app that utilizes Eventbrite & Ticketmaster APIs for seamless event discovery, interactive voting, and personalized schedule planning. It implements web scraping to compensate for missing functionality in Eventbrite's API.
projects.tech_stack: JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB

projects.title: Marvel Comic App
projects.description: A full-stack web application that integrates the Marvel API for comic discovery and collection.
projects.tech_stack: JavaScript, React, Node.js, GraphQL, Redis, Redux

projects.title: Support Vector Machine
projects.description: Coursework that involves deriving the hyperplane equation from given data points and Lagrange multipliers, calculating distances to the hyperplane, and classifying new points.

projects.title: Breast Cancer Detection
projects.description: Coursework that includes implementing logistic regression from scratch for breast cancer diagnosis, with a focus on Stochastic and Mini-Batch Gradient Descent optimizations, and model performance evaluation through precision, recall, and accuracy metrics.

projects.title: Diabetes Detection (PCA)
projects.description: Coursework that involves dimensionality reduction on a diabetes dataset using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), implemented with Python's sklearn library. PCA was applied to reduce the feature space from eight dimensions to two.

projects.title: Image Compression (SVD)
projects.description: Coursework that involves the practical application of Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to compress images. SVD was used to decompose and reconstruct images at varying levels of compression.

projects.title: Memory Maker
projects.description: An iOS app for suggesting compositions in mobile photography and for virtual postcard sharing. It achieved 2nd place in the competition for the International ICT Innovative Services Awards.

paragraphs: I'm from Taiwan and moved to the US for a CS master's at Stevens. I like web development, and I like digging into AI and machine learning. Building a project with unfamiliar tech is how I learn fastest.
Away from the keyboard you'll find me snowboarding, taking photos, watching anime, or playing Pokémon.
